AccessNodeData: The accessibility information a node exposes to assistive technology.
AccessNodeData.role: The kind of control the node is, such as button or slider.
AccessNodeData.label: The name read out for the node.
AccessNodeData.description: A longer hint read out after the label.
AccessNodeData.states: The node's state flags, such as disabled.
AccessNodeData.actions: The actions assistive technology can ask the node to perform.
AccessNodeData.value: The node's current value, as text or a number.
AccessNodeData.value_min: The smallest value a range control accepts.
AccessNodeData.value_max: The largest value a range control accepts.
AccessNodeData.value_step: The amount a range control changes per step.
AccessNodeData.checked: Whether a checkable node is checked.
AccessNodeData.selected: Whether a selectable node is selected.
AccessNodeData.expanded: Whether an expandable node is open.
AccessNodeData.live: How politely changes to this node are announced.
AccessNodeData.focusable: Forces the node focusable or not; None uses the node kind's default.
AccessNodeData.tab_index: The Tab order key; positive first, then zero in tree order, negative skipped.
AccessNodeData::new: Creates accessibility data with the given role and nothing else set.
AccessNodeData::offered_actions: Lists every action offered, including those implied by the role and state.
AccessNodeData::with_action: Returns this data with one more action added.
AccessNodeData::with_label: Returns this data with the label set.
AccessStates: The state flags of an accessible node.
ActiveAnimation: A running animation: its start and end values, timing and curve.
ActiveAnimation.from: The value the animation started from.
ActiveAnimation.to: The value the animation is heading toward.
ActiveAnimation.curve: The easing curve that shapes the motion.
ActiveAnimation.on_complete: The handle reported when the animation finishes, if any.
Animated: A value that can move smoothly to a new target over time.
Animated.current: The value right now, between start and target while animating.
Animated.active: The running animation, or None when the value is at rest.
Animated::animate_to: Starts, or replaces, an animation toward a new value.
Animated::animate_to_with_completion: Starts an animation and reports a handle when it finishes.
Animated::new: Creates a value at rest at the given initial value.
Animated::stop: Stops any animation and leaves the value where it had reached.
Animated::target: Returns where the value is heading, or the current value when at rest.
Animated::tick: Advances the animation to a time; true while it is still running.
CanvasState: The drawing commands and hit-test rule of a canvas node.
CanvasState.commands: The draw commands the canvas paints, in order.
CanvasState.hit_test: A custom hit-test rule; None uses the node's ordinary rectangle test.
CanvasState::new: Creates an empty canvas with no commands.
CompletionHandle: An opaque token identifying an animation-finished callback.
CompletionHandle.0: The numeric id of the callback.
CornerRadii: Four corner radii that animate as one value.
CornerRadii.0: Radii in the order top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left.
DockLayout: The docking zones of a window, one slot per side plus the center.
DockLayout.zones: The zone for each dock side, or None where none is registered.
DockLayout::new: Creates a layout with no zones.
DockLayout::set_zone: Registers a zone on a side, replacing any existing one.
DockLayout::zone: Returns the zone on a side, if any.
DockLayout::zone_mut: Returns the zone on a side for modification, if any.
DockZone: One docking zone: its panels, which tab is showing, and its size.
DockZone.panels: The panel nodes in this zone, tabbed together when there is more than one.
DockZone.active_tab: The index of the panel currently shown.
DockZone.size: The zone's extent in pixels, animatable.
DockZone::new: Creates an empty zone with the given size.
ImageState: A file-backed or pixel-supplied image and how it fits its node.
ImageState.content_fit: How the image fits a box of a different aspect ratio, like CSS object-fit.
ImageState::new: Creates image state from pixel data with the default fit.
Modifiers: The modifier keys held while an event happens.
Modifiers.meta: Whether the Meta (Super or Command) key is held.
Node: One element in the tree, with its place, layout, paint and accessibility data.
Node.parent: The node's parent, or None for a root.
Node.kind: What the node is, such as a rectangle, text or image, with its state.
Node.layout_style: The layout style that sizes and positions the node.
Node.paint: The node's paint properties, such as background, opacity and shadows.
Node.access: The node's accessibility data; default until the app opts in.
NodeId: A stable handle to a node, safe to hold after the node is removed.
NodeTransform: Translation, scale and rotation, each animatable, applied about the box center.
NodeTransform::to_affine: Returns the current transform for a box of the given size.
OverlayMeta: The settings of one open overlay or layer.
OverlayMeta.anchor: The node the overlay is positioned against.
OverlayMeta.dismiss_on_outside_click: Whether a press outside the overlay dismisses it.
OverlayMeta.modal: Whether the overlay blocks all interaction with what is behind it.
OverlayMeta.dismissible: Whether dismissal is reported to the app instead of closing the overlay itself.
OverlayMeta.placement: The side of the anchor the overlay prefers.
OverlayMeta.placed: The side the last layout actually used.
OverlayMeta.restore_focus: The node to give focus back to when the overlay closes.
PaintProperties: The paint state every node has, whatever its kind.
PaintProperties.corner_radius: The corner radius in pixels, animatable.
PaintProperties.opacity: The node's opacity from 0.0 to 1.0, animatable.
PaintProperties.transform: A transform that composes with the parent's down the tree.
PaintProperties.border_color: The border color, drawn inside the node's edge.
PaintProperties.corner_radii_override: Per-corner radii that replace the single corner radius when set.
PaintProperties.node_transform: Translate, scale and rotate applied about the box center.
PaintProperties.clip_children: Whether children are clipped to this node's box.
PaintProperties::local_transform: Returns the node's full local transform for a box of the given size.
PaintProperties::new: Creates paint properties with a background, corner radius and opacity.
PaintProperties::tick: Advances every animated field; true while any is still running.
PathData: Vector path geometry that can be animated between shapes.
PathData::from_svg: Parses SVG path data into a path, or returns an error message.
PathData::to_svg: Returns the path as SVG path data.
PathState: The state of a path node: shape, view box and stroke trim.
PathState.view_box: The region of path space fitted into the node's box; None uses pixels.
PathState.trim_start: Where the drawn stroke starts along the path, from 0.0 to 1.0.
PathState.trim_end: Where the drawn stroke ends along the path, from 0.0 to 1.0.
PathState::geometry: Returns the path fitted into a box and its trimmed stroke outline.
PathState::new: Creates path state from path data with no view box and no trim.
PathState::tick: Advances every animated field; true while any is still running.
ScrollViewState: The state of a scroll view: offset, direction and scrollbar look.
ScrollViewState.scroll: The scroll offset in pixels, animatable.
ScrollViewState.horizontal: Whether the view scrolls horizontally instead of vertically.
ScrollViewState.thumb_drag_anchor: The pointer position and scroll offset at the start of a thumb drag.
ScrollViewState.scrollbar_fill: The scrollbar thumb color; None uses the default.
ScrollViewState.scrollbar_width: The scrollbar thumb thickness in pixels.
ScrollViewState.reported: The offset last reported to the app as a scroll event.
ScrollViewState::new: Creates scroll state, horizontal or vertical.
ScrollViewState::thumb_geometry: Returns the scrollbar track length, thumb length and thumb position.
Shader: A validated WGSL shader with its uniforms, inputs and mode.
Shader::animated: Whether the shader changes with time and needs a redraw every frame.
Shader::mode: Whether the shader fills the node or is an effect on its content.
ShaderError: A shader problem, positioned in the app's source when possible.
ShaderError.line: The 1-based line in the app's source, if known.
ShaderError.column: The 1-based byte column in the app's source, if known.
ShaderError.source_line: The text of the source line the error is on.
Shadow: One drop shadow, drawn like a CSS box-shadow.
Shadow.spread: Pixels the shadow grows beyond the node's box.
Shadows: A node's list of drop shadows, the first painted on top.
TerminalCell: One character cell of a terminal grid, with its colors and style.
TerminalCell.ch: The character shown in the cell.
TerminalCell.inverse: Whether foreground and background are swapped.
TerminalCell::blank: Returns an empty cell: a space with a transparent background.
TerminalPalette: Every color a terminal paints: ANSI colors, defaults, cursor and selection.
TerminalPalette::background_of: Resolves a cell color to an actual color, using the default background.
TerminalPalette::foreground_of: Resolves a cell color to an actual color, using the default foreground.
TerminalPalette::indexed: Returns one of the 256 indexed colors.
TerminalState: A terminal's current cell grid, cursor, selection and fonts.
TerminalState.cells: The cells in row-major order, columns times rows long.
TerminalState.font_family: The font family used to draw the grid.
TerminalState.selection_start: The row and column where the mouse selection began.
TerminalState.selection_end: The row and column where the mouse selection currently ends.
TerminalState.palette: The colors the terminal paints with.
TerminalState::cell: Returns the cell at a row and column; panics when out of bounds.
TerminalState::new: Creates a blank grid of the given size and font.
TerminalState::resize_grid: Resizes the grid, keeping cells that still fit and blanking the rest.
TextFieldState: The state of an editable text field: content, cursor, selection and styling.
TextFieldState.cursor: The caret position as a byte offset into the content.
TextFieldState.selection_anchor: The fixed end of the selection as a byte offset; None when nothing is selected.
TextFieldState.preedit: The uncommitted text of an input-method composition, if any.
TextFieldState.text_tint: The color of the text, caret and selection, animatable.
TextFieldState.multiline: Whether the field holds several lines instead of one.
TextFieldState.show_whitespace: Whether spaces and tabs are drawn as visible marks.
TextFieldState.syntax_spans: Byte ranges with colors supplied by the app for syntax highlighting.
TextFieldState.folded_ranges: Byte ranges of the content that are hidden (folded) when painting.
TextFieldState.goal_column: The column kept while moving the caret up or down across lines.
TextFieldState.scroll_offset: The vertical scroll of an overflowing multiline field, animatable.
TextFieldState.horizontal_scroll_offset: The horizontal scroll of an overflowing line, animatable.
TextFieldState::new: Creates a field with the caret at the end of the content.
TextOptions: Line-layout options for text: wrapping, spacing, line limits and italics.
TextState: The state of a text node: content, font, alignment and layout options.
TextState.font_weight: The font weight from 100.0 to 950.0; 400.0 is normal.
TextState.align: How lines are aligned within the node's width.
TextState.line_height: The line height as a multiple of the font size; None uses the font's own.
TextState.options: Line layout options beyond the font.
VirtualListState: The state of a virtual list, which builds only the visible items.
VirtualListState.item_count: The total number of items in the list.
VirtualListState.item_extent: How tall each item is: fixed or variable.
VirtualListState.materialized: The item index to node map of the items currently built.
VirtualListState.scroll_offset: The vertical scroll position in pixels, animatable.
VirtualListState.resolved_offsets: Cached top offsets of items in a variable-height list.
VirtualListState.thumb_drag_anchor: The pointer position and scroll offset at the start of a thumb drag.
VirtualListState::new: Creates list state for a number of items and an extent rule.
VirtualListState::offset_of: Returns the top offset of an item.
VirtualListState::thumb_geometry: Returns the scrollbar track length, thumb length and thumb position.
VirtualListState::total_extent: Returns the combined height of all items.
